posts.community: Dynamic Cables - Much more dynamic in 2022?
posts.text: I was reviewing the annual reports of Dynamic Cables and came across an interesting disclosure that I haven’t seen discussed in detail on the forum. The FY25 Annual Report specifically mentions the ₹5 crore corporate guarantee provided to Mangal Electrical Industries in the Auditor’s Report. However, the Related Party Transactions note also discloses corporate guarantees of approximately ₹344.75 crore , which appear against Shiv Kripa Pipes in earlier years and Indokrates Pvt.
